description: Fix 5 (2026-05-23 follow-up) regression guard for the section-break tail freeze. A clip with authored duration much shorter than its trimmed source range, ending exactly at a section break with non-zero fadeSeconds, used to make the SeekSyncController preroll gate ask the FrameCache for `mediaStartFrame + sourceLength - 1` (the trimmed-source-end the worker never decoded) on every tick after Section GO — the gate stalled for its full 3000ms timeout. The held frame is now `mapToMediaFrame(clip, clipEnd - 1)` (the frame the clip actually displayed at its last authored timeline frame), which the worker has already decoded; the gate releases on the first tick and playback advances within tens of milliseconds. Setup: tone_1khz.mov fixture is 150 frames at 30fps; SetClipDuration to 30 makes the authored window 30 frames but the trimmed source range is still 150 (mediaOutFrame defaults to -1, so effectivePlaybackLength = totalMediaFrames = 150). Section break at frame 30 with fadeSeconds=2.0 → 60-frame fade tail. SectionBehavior is set to Locked so this stays a held-frame test; the 2026-05-23 follow-up amendment routes Normal-mode break-aligned ends with longer source content through the new active-window extension instead of held-frame semantics (see normal_mode_extends_past_break.json for that path).
